entities.summary: Sander Arends is a Dutch professional tennis player who specializes in doubles. He has a career-high ATP doubles ranking of world No. 23, achieved on 21 July 2025. Arends has won four doubles ATP Tour titles, one with David Pel and three with Luke Johnson.
